chirp verb

also tweet, peep, chirp (of a cricket)

classical

Traupman 141, 144
Varr. ap. Non. 156.25: gallīna pīpat
Traupman 290

pīpō, pīpāre

verb, first conjugation

chirp, peep

Other words

  • pīpilō, pīpilāre — chirp, peep

    verb, first conjugation · also used · late Latin · Traupman 141, 144; Traupman 290

  • pīpiō, pīpiāre

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Catull. 3.10: ad sōlam dominam ūsque pīpiābat

    Of Lesbia’s sparrow. Lewis & Short, on an older reading, cites the line as pīpilābat.

  • fritinniō, fritinnīre — to chirp, twitter (of small birds and the cicada)

    verb, fourth conjugation · also used · classical · Varr. ap. Non. 7.15: pullōs peperit fritinnientēs (Lewis & Short); Traupman 142, 143, 144; Varr. ap. Non. 7.15 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 290

See also sparrow, chick.
